system.description:
The "Grizzly Slam" you use can move the target up to 2Sq with [Immediate Movement (Force)]. This massive gauntlet gives the illusion of being worn by a race one size larger than the wearer. When the keyword is chanted, a colossal arm reminiscent of the giant Atlas manifests as spiritual energy. While damage isn't increased, any opponent caught in the sweep of this massive arm will be staggered.

Dull Shell [Core Material] (120G) + Merkin Sack (210G) + Arm Guard (150G) + [Magic Catalyst 7] (60G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (310G)
